name: Tymolin Loneglade
description: Tev's sister, an accomplished fighter enchanted with eternal youth, whose death transforms Tev.

description_citations.text: "Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaylen is killed by an orc in a dwarven fortress while he and Tymolin hold back invading Orcs and Goblins; Tymolin slays the orc and then heads to Havenwood to find Tev.
timeline.quote: Sneaking behind Kaylen an orc runs him through from behind before Tymolin can warn him.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 1: Rumors of War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oliver Farrel whips Montford into a frenzy against the Ebon Hand and appoints Sianna as his champion to slay Tymolin.
timeline.quote: Farrel then appoints Sianna to be his champion bestowing his mantle upon her.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 1: Rumors of War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Farrelites ambush Tev and Tymolin; Tev summons a Wall of Bone, disenchants Farrel's mantle and escapes with a Darkness spell, but the siblings are separated.
timeline.quote: Not recognizing Tev to be a powerful planeswalker the blood cult attacks the pair ignoring him.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 1: Rumors of War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vaylesh captures Tymolin and lures the Farrelites to the Ebon Hand camp; Farrel stabs Tymolin to death when she refuses him.
timeline.quote: Refusing his request, Tymolin is stabbed to death by Farrel while still tied up.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 2: Nations Asunder". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tev and Tymolin are caught up in the Brothers' War with disastrous results, leaving Tev guilt-ridden and exiled from society in Sarpadia.
timeline.quote: Tev was left guilt-ridden, and eventually the two returned to Sarpadia where Tev chose to exile himself from society.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaylen falls in battle when an orc stabs him from behind during an attack on the Dwarven empire.
timeline.quote: Kaylen fell in battle when he was stabbed from behind by an orc.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tev refuses Tymolin's plea to intervene against the forces of chaos.
timeline.quote: Tev continued his lack of intrusion, refusing to either stop the orcs and goblins or help the dwarves.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oliver Farrel and the Farrelites attack Tev and Tymolin; Tev disenchants Sianna's cloak and Tymolin is separated from him.
timeline.quote: Oliver Farrel and his Farrelites attacked Tev and Tymolin.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Transformation to Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tymolin is captured by Vaylesh and the Ebon Hand and stabbed to death by Farrel.
timeline.quote: which backfired when Farrel stabbed Tymolin to death.

timeline.summary: Szat reflects on Dominaria and his sister, blaming himself for Tymolin's death.
timeline.quote: all pleasure perished when he let Tymolin die
